title: DIAG world and regional audit (protocol E.7 / section 10)
_source: ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md E.7, transcribed mechanically per ralph/GATE_F_INSTRUMENTATION_REQUEST.md section 6. Entry save per protocol B: 'any; teleport permitted'.
_diag: This is a DIAG segment. E.7: 'X07 then revisits each region under DIAG teleport for the audit grid -- allowed because this audits the world, not the route.' Protocol 0.6 is absolute and travels with every frame here: NO pacing, navigation, difficulty or economy claim may ever be sourced from a DIAG segment. Every teleport step below carries "diag": true.
_hud: Protocol G's HUD rule: 'HUD ON default. hud:off is permitted only where marked (composition audit frames), and each hud:off frame requires a paired hud:on context frame within 30 s.' The GF-AUD family is the one place hud:off is allowed. Each region block captures its hud:on gameplay frame FIRST and then its five hud:off composition frames back to back, so the hud:on frame is the pair for all five and is seconds, not 30 s, away.
_pins: E.7: 'pin-and-freeze the WorldLook clock using the capture_band3_region.gd pattern -- never the unpinned variant that produced the 2026-08-23 crimson artefact -- and record every pin in telemetry as DIAG'. Every pin below is a note step, and the note is the telemetry record the protocol asks for.
_unflattering: E.7: 'the operator supplies frames, including unflattering ones -- do not take only flattering screenshots; the shot plan's fixed positions exist precisely so the frame is the frame'. The positions in this file are fixed before play and may not be moved to improve a composition.

steps.title: what this segment is

args.text: E.7's audit grid over every region. The journey segments capture every ARRIVAL shot naturally (protocol G classes 2-13); this revisits each region under DIAG teleport for the grid.

steps.expected: a note event carries this observation into events.jsonl

steps.title: VOCABULARY GAP: no action pins the WorldLook clock

args.text: E.7 requires the pin-and-freeze pattern and warns explicitly against the unpinned variant that produced the 2026-08-23 crimson artefact. SEGMENT_SCHEMA.md's vocabulary has no clock-pin action: `wait` advances the clock and nothing freezes it. Every pin below is therefore recorded as a note -- which is what the protocol asks for -- but the pin itself has to be performed by the harness invocation (tools/gate_f/run_segment.sh, capture_band3_region.gd's own pattern) rather than by a step. Reported before the freeze: a `pin_clock` action is a harness change, and after the freeze the operator cannot make one.

steps.expected: a note event carries this observation into events.jsonl

steps.title: AMBIGUITY: the Stronghold approach has no region entry

args.text: E.7's region list ends 'plus the Stronghold approach and Hall', and data/config/map_landmarks.json has a region for neither -- the Hall is a LANDMARK at (150,7595) and the approach is not in the file at all. The Hall uses its landmark position. The approach uses (-65,7028), the midpoint of RT-11's two anchors -- the sigil gate at (-280,6460) from RT-10 and the Hall threshold at (150,7595) -- which is protocol G's own 'RT-11 mid' for GF-12-APPR-02. Both region_is asserts on those two blocks will FAIL, because no region id contains them; the FAIL is the record that the two places the protocol audits are not named on the map.

steps.expected: a note event carries this observation into events.jsonl
